FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.created_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.segment
HAVING SUM(o.total) > 1000
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
